target: the two halves of the contract for a tool that rewrites the project's memory: it never LOSES a line and never INVENTS one. Pins three real defects — a content line shaped like an internal marker was silently dropped, an empty file crashed under bash 3.2 set -u, and a corrupted rewrite could emit a line that was never in the source while line counts stayed equal.
cmd:
L="$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh"; printf "# L

## Lessons

- [2026-07-01] a
" > s.md; printf '%s
' '\000ENT:0' >> s.md; printf -- "- [2026-07-02] b
" >> s.md; b1=$(wc -l < s.md|tr -d " "); "$L" consolidate s.md >/dev/null 2>&1; a1=$(wc -l < s.md|tr -d " "); kept=$(grep -c 'ENT:0' s.md); bak=$(ls s.md.*.bak 2>/dev/null | head -1); invented=$(while IFS= read -r l; do grep -qxF -- "$l" "$bak" || echo x; done < s.md | wc -l | tr -d " "); cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/exact_dupes.md" d.md; "$L" consolidate d.md >/dev/null 2>&1; dbak=$(ls d.md.*.bak 2>/dev/null | head -1); dinv=$(while IFS= read -r l; do grep -qxF -- "$l" "$dbak" || echo x; done < d.md | wc -l | tr -d " "); : > e.md; "$L" consolidate e.md >/dev/null 2>&1; ec=$?; printf "# L

## Lessons
" > h.md; "$L" consolidate h.md >/dev/null 2>&1; hc=$?; hl=$(wc -l < h.md|tr -d " "); printf '{"before":%s,"after":%s,"sentinelKept":%s,"invented":%s,"dupInvented":%s,"emptyRc":%s,"headingsRc":%s,"headingLines":%s}' "$b1" "$a1" "$kept" "$invented" "$dinv" "$ec" "$hc" "$hl"

checks.expr: .before == .after and .sentinelKept == 1 and .invented == 0 and .dupInvented == 0 and .emptyRc == 0 and .headingsRc == 0 and .headingLines == 3

provenance.note: spec 012 revision 1 — both bugs found by adversarial input testing
